Job Description

As a Dispatch and Labelling Line Supervisor  you will have a varied and responsible role.

Under the guidance of the Dispatch Team Leader, you will ensure that labelling and packaging activities are carried out correctly, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You will coordinate and guide the employees working on the production line, ensuring that every product meets the applicable quality and food safety requirements, as well as customer specifications.

You will gradually grow into your role. You will start by being responsible for one production line. As you gain experience, the aim is for you to be able to operate and supervise all lines.

The Line Supervisor has an operational, monitoring, and coordinating role on the shop floor. You will ensure that the daily production schedule is completed within the allocated time while maintaining the required quality standards.

 

A selection of your responsibilities:

• Allocate tasks, provide clear work instructions, and guide employees working in filling and labelling. You will also help train new colleagues.

• Set up, operate, and change over packaging and labelling machines. Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently and report defects to the technical department in a timely manner.

• Check labels: use the ERP system to assign the correct production order to the right line and ensure that every product receives the correct label.

• Perform and record quality checks, including metal detection, residual oxygen measurements, visual packaging inspections, seal integrity checks, and final product weight checks.

• Ensure that each customer's packaging, labelling, and palletising instructions are followed correctly. Check stacking patterns, quantities, and pallet labels.

• Monitor compliance with HACCP, IFS Food, Food Defense, and hygiene requirements, and report any deviations to the Quality Department or your supervisor.

 

Who are you?

 

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English, including speaking, understanding, and reading. French is an advantage!

• You have experience working as an operator in another company, preferably in the food industry.

• You are familiar with packaging and labelling machines, including operating, setting up, and changing them over.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are stress-resistant and comfortable working at a fast pace on machinery. Things can get quite busy at Kjure-Marblo!

• You have strong administrative skills and are confident using computers.

• As working in the food industry involves strict quality, hygiene, and safety requirements, gel nails, excessive make-up, eyelash extensions, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted. We prefer a natural look. :-)

• You are comfortable working in a cold environment, with temperatures around 4°C.

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.
 
 Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment.
 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

Job description:

• Packaging and labeling products

• Preparing orders accurately for shipment

• Ensuring quality and a high standard of presentation

• Assisting with peeling and preparing the potatoes

• Carrying out quality control checks

• Maintaining cleanliness and order in the workplace

• Assisting wherever needed

 

• you speak Dutch en English

• Physical work is not a problem

• Able to get to the company independently (no public transportation available)

• Previous production experience is required

• Willing to work in food production

• Flexible

• Quality-oriented and positive attitude

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly?

As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:30 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• Strong organizational and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

• Willingness to work night shifts.

• Experience in a food production or manufacturing environment is an advantage.

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Our client is an engineering company.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.

• Experience managing IT suppliers, licenses, assets, procurement activities, and budget-related processes.
• Experience with ISO 27001 implementation is a strong plus.
• Proven ability to operate independently as a local IT point of contact while collaborating effectively with centralised Group IT functions.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder-management, and organisational skills.
• Professional fluency in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an advantage.
• Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and provide support outside standard working hours when required.
• Relevant Microsoft, networking, ITIL, or cybersecurity certifications are considered an advantage.

jobs.occupation: EMEA Sales Manager - Specialty Polymers & Elastomer Materials
jobs.description:
The role focuses on managing and developing relationships with large international customers across the industrial materials sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Manager your responsibilities are:

• Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve business objectives.
• Manage and grow key accounts, ensuring long-term relationships with clients.
• Identify market opportunities and devise plans to capitalise on them.
• Monitor sales performance and analyse data to improve results.
• Collaborate with internal teams to align sales strategies with company goals.
• Lead and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and collective targets.
• Prepare and present regular sales reports to senior management.
• Stay updated on retail market trends and competitor activities.

A successful Sales Manager should have:

• 10  years of experience in sales and business development.
• Proven success managing international and global key accounts.
• Strong background in specialty materials, raw materials, polymers, plastics, compounding, or related industrial sectors.
• Experience within the TPE/TPC/SBC market is highly desirable.
• Demonstrated ability to develop business and grow strategic customer relationships.
• Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and ability to close complex deals.
• Fluent English (written and verbal).
• Comfortable working within a multicultural and international environment.
• Highly autonomous, self-motivated, and capable of working independently.
• Willingness to travel extensively across the region.

Our client is a leading international industrial group headquartered in Belgium. To support several members of the Executive Committee, the company is looking for a dynamic and proactive Executive Assistant in Brussels.

• You are organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities.
• You are comfortable working autonomously and taking initiative.
• You communicate professionally and confidently with senior stakeholders.

The client is a leading international industrial organization operating in a complex, high-volume manufacturing environment, with a strong focus on operational excellence, continuous improvement, and supply chain performance.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead, coordinate, and monitor day-to-day warehouse and distribution activities, ensuring operational priorities, service levels, inventory accuracy, and delivery requirements are met.
• Manage workforce planning and resource allocation, while overseeing warehouse personnel and ensuring the effective use of warehouse space, equipment, and operational resources.
• Develop and monitor operating and investment budgets, ensuring strong cost control and alignment with departmental objectives and performance KPIs.
• Identify and implement process, technology, equipment, and organizational improvements to optimize logistics operations and drive continuous improvement across the supply chain.

jobs.occupation: Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international organisation with a strong reputation for operational excellence and a people-focused culture. 

To strengthen its local IT presence in Belgium, our client is looking for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys working in a collaborative and multicultural environment. The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

Jobomschrijving

As a Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2), your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.
• Managing incidents, service requests, and technical queries in line with established processes and service level agreements.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.
• Acting as the primary local IT point of contact for employees based in Belgium.
• Logging, tracking, documenting, and resolving tickets using the company's IT Service Management platform.
• Collaborating with international IT teams, vendors, and specialist support teams to resolve complex issues.
• Monitoring IT systems and escalating recurring or critical issues when required.
• Supporting IT projects, deployments, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
• Managing employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware preparation, account setup, and access management.
• Supporting meeting room technology, printers, audiovisual equipment, and local IT infrastructure.
• Creating and maintaining user documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational procedures.
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance service quality, and optimise the overall user experience.

The successful candidate will have:

• At least 2/3 years of experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or End User Support role.
• Fluency in English & Dutch. French is a plus. 
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, end-user computing, networking fundamentals, and IT security best practices.
• Experience managing incidents, service requests, and change-related activities.
• Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Microsoft 365 user administration.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve technical issues independently.
• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.

ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.

On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.
